scenes.title: Don't buy these Ford Bronco II years

scenes.body: The Ranger Station says 1986–88 2.9 heads are known to crack, and rates 1985–87 A4LD automatics the least reliable.
Still crack-prone 2.9 heads and the early A4LD, which The Ranger Station's builder's guide says to stay away from.
Redesigned 89TM 2.9 heads largely eliminate the cracking, and The Ranger Station rates 1989-on A4LDs noticeably better than 1985–87.
